components.name: @lorewardens/core
components.description: Domain types, strictness gating, canon snapshot/store, minimal-context selector, agent contract, agent registry

components.name: Living Canon store
components.description: Writer-confirmed canon persistence; v0 InMemoryCanonStore, file-backed store follows

components.name: @lorewardens/agents
components.description: Continuity agents: canon-lore, character-consistency, timeline (stub agents ship with foundations)

components.name: @lorewardens/mcp-server
components.description: Local stdio MCP server exposing each enabled agent as a tool; zero network, non-destructive

components.name: @lorewardens/proof
components.description: Seeded-error manuscript + automated suite proving standard strictness catches every seeded error; clean passages stay silent

components.name: @lorewardens/bridge
components.description: Loopback HTTP bridge (127.0.0.1 only) serving the same engine path as the MCP server: token + Origin + Host guards, /analyze, /settings/:projectId, /health; no egress, read-only fixtures

components.name: @lorewardens/docs-extension
components.description: MV3 Google Docs extension (load unpacked, stable id via pinned manifest key): incremental analysis, findings as native Docs comments plus side panel, OAuth Testing mode via chrome.identity.launchWebAuthFlow

components.name: Google Docs integration
components.description: Browser extension and/or Docs API + sidebar/comments, OAuth Testing mode, unpacked extension for local testing (superseded in build by the bridge + docs-extension components)

components.name: Extended agent roster (14 more agents)
components.description: Domain, Language & Prose, Narrative, Optional families per project-files/Lorewardens Agents.md; same contract
